chunks.text:
[The Hour Strikes]
{on beat one: a sharp orchestral hit with timpani, the pendulum bass and ticking percussion already in motion, straight into the theme}
positive_styles: 3/4 waltz time like a great clock
low pendulum bass swinging root and fifth every bar
deep tolling tower bell on the hour
soft clock-tick percussion: woodblock and tom on the downbeat
awed mysterious legendary encounter, vast and ancient, solemn but tense
full ensemble from the first beat
same tempo, key and instruments as the theme that follows
